title: RNA-seq of PBMC derived macrophages derived from healthy donors in response to lipid A or TNF alpha (Dataset_170630_SysmedIBD_RNA_HEngland)
description: This aim of this study is to understand changes in gene expression in PBMC-derived macrophages (from healthy individuals) in response to lipid A or TNF alpha stimulation

samples.title: Sample 2
samples.description: Protocols: Blood samples were collected from 3 healthy volunteers and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) isolated by density gradient centrifugation on Ficoll. PBMCs were differentiated into macrophages using macrophage colony-stimulating factor (M-CSF). Cells were stimulated for 3h as detailed and total RNA extracted. PBMCs were differentiated to macrophages in RPMI + 10% FCS with 50ng/ml M-CSF for 8 days before stimulation. PBMC-derived macrophages were stimulated with either media alone, 200ng/ml lipid A or 50ng/ml TNF alpha for 3h before RNA isolation. ~2x10^6 cells were stimulated per condition. RNA was extracted using the mirVana RNA isolation kit according to the manufacturer's instructions. Input RNA quality was assessed on a TapeStation2200 using the RNA Screen Tape to confirm high RNA quality (RIN score > 8) according to manufacturers instructions. Input RNA quantity was assessed using a Qubit 2.0 Fluorometer and the Qubit RNA BR Assay Kit according to manufacturers instructions. Library was constructed using the Illumina TruSeq stranded total RNA kit according to manufacturers instructions with an input of 500 ng total RNA / sample. This kit includes ribosomal RNA removal by Ribozero treatment. The quality of final libraries was checked on a TapeStation2200 using the D1000 Screen Tape.
